mapper.insert: insert into user_assigned_region (assigned_region_id, user_id, region_id, create_time) values (#{assignedRegionId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{userId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{regionId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.delete: delete from user_assigned_region where user_id = #{userId} and region_id = #{regionId}
mapper.select: select assigned_region_id, user_id, region_id, create_time from user_assigned_region

select uar.assigned_region_id, uar.user_id, uar.region_id, fr.sido_name as sido, fr.name as sigungu, date_format(uar.create_time, '%Y.%m.%d') as assigned_date from user_assigned_region uar inner join fire_region fr on uar.region_id = fr.region_id where uar.user_id = #{userId} order by uar.create_time asc
